item.group_name: Composed pieces (several tools, one finished thing)
item.title: One Coffee Ad Three Shapes

turns.text: Make a coffee ad in three sizes: square 1:1, vertical 9:16 and wide 16:9. Use a steaming coffee cup, cream and dark green colours, and these words: “Daybreak Coffee”, “Fresh start. Better coffee.” and “Shop now”. Same campaign design across all three, rearranged to fit.

item.tests: Produces three genuinely adapted aspect-ratio variants of one cohesive ad rather than unrelated designs or cropped copies.

answer_sheet.Brand and exact wording: Daybreak Coffee; Fresh start. Better coffee.; Shop now
answer_sheet.Visual style: Cream and dark green with a steaming coffee cup; one consistent campaign.
answer_sheet.Source assets: No supplied assets; create the coffee imagery.

must_haves: Three separate finished images are supplied, one each in 1:1, 9:16 and 16:9.
All three feature a steaming coffee cup and a consistent cream-and-dark-green palette.
Each image contains the exact brand, headline and call to action specified.
The cup design, typography and visual styling clearly belong to the same campaign across all three images.
Each layout fits its canvas without stretched imagery, clipped copy or large blank padding used merely to change the aspect ratio.

style.prompt: Create a polished square still social media advertisement for a coffee brand. Warm sunrise product photography, rich amber and cream palette. Hero subject: a beautiful cream ceramic cup filled with fresh coffee, delicate steam rising, on a sunlit table with a few roasted coffee beans. Elegant uncluttered editorial layout, strong contrast and ample negative space for clear readable typography. Include exactly these three text elements, all lowercase, spelled precisely: brand at top 'daybreak coffee'; prominent headline 'fresh start. better coffee.'; and a refined call-to-action button at bottom reading 'shop now'. No other text, no extra logos, no watermarks. Premium inviting morning atmosphere, appetizing coffee, professional advertising art direction.
